description: Replace the current Canvas Size presets (1K, 2K, 4K) with flexible controls for exact output dimensions and aspect ratios

items.description: Display a row of aspect ratio preset buttons: 1:1 (default), 4:3, 3:2, 16:9, 9:16, and Custom. The selected preset should be visually highlighted to indicate it is 'locked'.
stepsToVerify: Open the application
Locate the Canvas Settings section
Verify 6 aspect ratio buttons are displayed in a row: 1:1, 4:3, 3:2, 16:9, 9:16, Custom
Verify 1:1 is selected/highlighted by default
Click each preset button and verify it becomes visually highlighted
Verify only one preset can be selected at a time

items.description: When 'Custom' aspect ratio is selected, display two small number inputs for defining an arbitrary ratio (width ratio and height ratio). These inputs should be hidden when any preset is selected.
stepsToVerify: Select a preset aspect ratio (e.g., 1:1)
Verify custom ratio inputs are NOT visible
Click the 'Custom' button
Verify two number input fields appear for width ratio and height ratio
Enter values like 21 and 9 to create a 21:9 ratio
Select a preset again and verify custom inputs disappear

items.description: Display two number input fields for Width and Height in pixels. Width is the primary/editable dimension. Height shows the calculated value based on the locked aspect ratio.
stepsToVerify: Locate the Width and Height input fields in Canvas Settings
Verify Width field accepts numeric input
Verify Height field displays the calculated dimension
Verify both fields show pixel values (not percentages or other units)

items.description: When an aspect ratio is locked (any preset or custom), editing the width should automatically recalculate and update the height. The height field should be read-only (not editable) when AR is locked.
stepsToVerify: Select 16:9 aspect ratio preset
Enter 1600 in the Width field
Verify Height automatically updates to 900 (1600 * 9/16)
Attempt to edit the Height field directly
Verify the Height field is read-only/disabled and cannot be edited
Select 4:3 aspect ratio
Verify Height recalculates to 1200 (1600 * 3/4)

items.description: When using custom aspect ratio inputs, the height should update based on the user-defined ratio when width is changed.
stepsToVerify: Select 'Custom' aspect ratio
Enter 21 for width ratio and 9 for height ratio
Enter 2100 in the Width field
Verify Height automatically updates to 900 (2100 * 9/21)
Change custom ratio to 5:4
Verify Height updates to 1680 (2100 * 4/5)

items.description: When user enters canvas dimensions, the system finds the valid cell size closest to the current setting that divides both width and height evenly. Valid cell sizes are common divisors of GCD(width, height) that are ≥ 8px. If no valid cell size ≥ 8px exists, snap dimensions to the nearest values that work with the current cell size.
stepsToVerify: Set cell size to 48px
Verify cell size auto-adjusts to 40px (closest valid divisor of GCD(1920,1080)=120)
Verify a warning appears explaining the cell size was adjusted
Enter dimensions like 997 x 563 (co-prime, only 1px works)
Verify dimensions snap instead (since no valid cell size ≥ 8px)
Verify warning explains dimensions were adjusted to align with current cell size

items.description: When cell size or dimensions are adjusted, display an inline toast warning explaining what was adjusted. Format: 'Cell size adjusted to [X]px to fit [W]×[H] dimensions' OR 'Dimensions adjusted to [W]×[H] to align with [X]px cells'. Warning auto-dismisses after 5 seconds or when user makes new changes. No stacking - new warnings replace old ones.
stepsToVerify: Trigger a cell size adjustment by entering valid dimensions
Verify inline toast appears with cell size adjustment message
Verify toast auto-dismisses after ~5 seconds
Trigger a dimension snap by entering co-prime dimensions
Verify toast shows dimension adjustment message
Make another change quickly - verify new toast replaces old one (no stacking)

items.description: Remove the 1K / 2K / 4K canvas size preset buttons from the UI.
stepsToVerify: Open the application
Search the entire UI for 1K, 2K, or 4K buttons
Verify these buttons no longer exist anywhere in the interface
Verify Canvas Settings section has the new aspect ratio and dimension controls instead

items.description: Rename 'Cell Scale' to 'Cell Size' for clarity. Provide preset options (8px, 16px, 24px, 32px, 48px, 64px) plus a custom input field allowing any value from 8px to 128px. Zoom controls (25%, 50%, 100%) remain unchanged.
stepsToVerify: Locate the Parameters section
Verify dropdown is labeled 'Cell Size' (not 'Cell Scale')
Verify preset options include common sizes: 8, 16, 24, 32, 48, 64px
Verify custom input field allows entering values 8-128px
Enter custom value 36px and verify it's accepted
Enter invalid value 4px and verify it's rejected (below minimum)
Verify Zoom controls (25%, 50%, 100%) are present and functional

items.description: Default state: 1000px width, 1000px height, 1:1 aspect ratio selected, cell size 40px (or nearest valid divisor of 1000). Note: 1000 has divisors including 8, 10, 20, 25, 40, 50, etc.
stepsToVerify: Refresh/reload the application to reset state
Verify Width field shows 1000px
Verify Height field shows 1000px
Verify 1:1 aspect ratio preset is selected/highlighted
Verify cell size is set to a valid divisor of 1000 (e.g., 40px)
Verify the generated fragment is square

items.description: Grid view should display fragments with their true aspect ratio without stretching. Items may have varying sizes to accommodate different proportions.
stepsToVerify: Set aspect ratio to 16:9
Switch to grid view
Verify each grid item displays with 16:9 aspect ratio (wider than tall)
Verify fragments are not stretched or distorted
Set aspect ratio to 9:16
Verify each grid item displays with 9:16 aspect ratio (taller than wide)
Verify the responsive grid layout still functions correctly

items.description: The Canvas Settings section should contain: 1) Aspect Ratio preset buttons in a row, 2) Custom ratio inputs (only when Custom is selected), 3) Width input field, 4) Height input field.
stepsToVerify: Locate Canvas Settings section
Verify aspect ratio buttons appear first in a horizontal row
Select 'Custom' and verify custom ratio inputs appear below the presets
Verify Width input field is present with label
Verify Height input field is present with label
Verify the layout is logical and follows the specified order

items.description: Show the current aspect ratio in simplified form. Display '1:1' for square, '4:3' for that preset, 'Custom' when using custom ratio inputs.
stepsToVerify: Select 1:1 preset and verify it displays as '1:1'
Select 4:3 preset and verify it displays as '4:3'
Select 16:9 preset and verify it displays as '16:9'
Select Custom and enter 21:9
Verify display shows 'Custom' or '21:9' appropriately

items.category: Behavior - Height Recalculation on Ratio Change
items.description: When the aspect ratio is changed (switching between presets or modifying custom values), the height should recalculate based on the current width and new ratio.
stepsToVerify: Set width to 1600px with 1:1 ratio (height = 1600)
Switch to 16:9 ratio
Verify height updates to 900 (1600 * 9/16)
Switch to 4:3 ratio
Verify height updates to 1200 (1600 * 3/4)
Switch to Custom and enter 2:1
Verify height updates to 800 (1600 * 1/2)

items.category: Edge Case - Manual Cell Size Change
items.description: When user manually changes cell size, dimensions stay fixed. If new cell size doesn't divide dimensions evenly, the system finds the nearest valid cell size ≥ 8px. If the user specifically wants that exact cell size via custom input, dimensions snap to fit instead.
stepsToVerify: Set dimensions to 1000 x 1000 with cell size 40px (valid)
Change cell size to 48px via dropdown
Verify cell size adjusts to nearest valid (50px or 40px, both divide 1000)
Or verify dimensions snap if 48px is forced via custom input with 'force' option
Verify warning appears explaining the adjustment
Verify aspect ratio is maintained

items.description: Validate all numeric inputs. Canvas dimensions: minimum 64px, maximum 4096px, integers only. Custom aspect ratio inputs: positive integers 1-99. Cell size custom input: 8px minimum, 128px maximum. Invalid inputs show inline validation error and revert to last valid value on blur.
stepsToVerify: Enter 50 in width field - verify error (below 64px minimum)
Enter 5000 in width field - verify error (above 4096px maximum)
Enter 'abc' in width field - verify error (not a number)
Enter 12.5 in width field - verify it rounds to integer
Enter 0 in custom ratio field - verify error
Enter 150 in custom ratio field - verify error (above 99 max)
Verify invalid fields revert to last valid value on blur

items.description: Algorithm for finding valid cell size: 1) Calculate GCD of width and height, 2) Find all divisors of GCD that are ≥ 8px, 3) Select divisor closest to current cell size, 4) If no divisors ≥ 8px exist, snap dimensions instead using original cell size.
stepsToVerify: Enter 1920 x 1080 with current cell size 48px
Closest to 48 is 40, verify cell size becomes 40px
Enter 1024 x 768 with cell size 48px
Closest to 48 is 32 or 64 - verify one is selected
